Under state compliance guidelines, any student missing 10% or more instructional days (<85% attendance rate) is legally designated as Chronically Absent. This triggers MTSS Tier 2 early intervention contracts.

Issue 6 • Room 101 Family Dispatch • November 2025 Edition.

ROOM 101 DISPATCH

Oakridge Elementary School • Mrs. Sarah Jenkins • Fall Term Issue 6 • Nov 2025

What We Are Learning This Fortnight

Mathematics: Students have successfully mastered solving two-step equations using hands-on algebra tiles. This week we transition to real-world word problems and coordinate graphs.

General Science: In Lab 301, students observed mitotic cell division on onion root tip slides under compound microscopes. Their sketches and scientific notes are outstanding!

STEM Robotics: Teams are programming ultrasonic sonar sensors on Arduino breadboards to navigate small obstacles.

Important Dates
Nov 20: Parent-Teacher Conferences (Half-day dismissal)
Nov 28: Annual STEM Fair Kickoff
Dec 20: Winter Vacation Begins
Student of the Month
Emma Johnson
For exceptional kindness and leadership as peer algebra tutor!

Complete User Guide

Printing & Reports Guide

Print clean class schedules, progress slips, rubric sheets & sub folders as PDF:

  • Open the tab you want (e.g. Progress Reports or Sub Folder)
  • Press Ctrl + P or click Print Report
  • Choose Save as PDF with Background Graphics enabled
  • Use A4 Portrait for slips & Landscape for Gradebooks

Backup & Data Safety Guide

Your student & grade records belong exclusively to you on this device:

  • Data is stored privately in browser localStorage (no external server)
  • Download a full .json backup every Friday before closing
  • Avoid clearing "Site Data / Cookies" unless backed up
  • Enable PIN Lock in Settings for shared school laptops

Offline Usage Guide

Checking...

Using EditNook smoothly in classrooms with weak or no internet:

  • All editing, attendance, timers & grading work 100% offline
  • Keep the page open or bookmark the local file path
  • Exports (.json / .csv) generate directly inside your browser
  • Online needed once initially to cache fonts & chart visuals
